guard: The dead zone is refused when the program is read (L2004), a named function expression binds its own name, bigint literals are refused (L1030), and a literal worktree shared across branches of one concurrent scope is refused while one branch keeps its own tree (L3022). (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: references into the dead zone resolve silently, the shipped defect
mutations.expectRed: a block reference above a shadowing `let` is the dead zone, not the outer binding
mutations.completionMarker: ok the worked example from the design doc, at the top level
mutations.cell: a block reference above a shadowing `let` is the dead zone, not the outer binding
mutations.note: With the check gone the reference resolves to the outer binding and validates, which is the measured pre-fix behavior (the program logged "outer", a meaning JavaScript never gave it).

mutations.name: a function boundary no longer defers the dead zone, so mutual recursion is refused
mutations.expectRed: a nested function may reference a binding declared later: it runs later
mutations.completionMarker: ok a block reference above a shadowing `let` is the dead zone, not the outer binding
mutations.cell: a nested function may reference a binding declared later: it runs later
mutations.note: The exemption is load-bearing in the other direction: without it every closure over a later binding — the mutual-recursion shape — is refused. Note the marker here is the L2004 cell itself (upstream), proving the refusal side still held while the acceptance side broke.

mutations.name: parameters bind all-at-once instead of left to right
mutations.expectRed: a parameter default may not read a LATER parameter
mutations.completionMarker: ok a block reference above a shadowing `let` is the dead zone, not the outer binding
mutations.cell: a parameter default may not read a LATER parameter
mutations.note: Without the pending marks a default sees every parameter, and `f(a = b, b = 1)` resolves — the measured pre-fix behavior, where the interpreter then read the OUTER `b` and returned 9.

mutations.name: a named function expression does not bind its own name
mutations.expectRed: a named function expression recurses through its own name
mutations.completionMarker: ok a block reference above a shadowing `let` is the dead zone, not the outer binding
mutations.cell: a named function expression recurses through its own name
mutations.note: The declare under mutation is the FunctionExpression id binding; without it `walk` inside the body is L2001, the measured pre-fix behavior.

mutations.name: bigint literals validate
mutations.expectRed: a bigint literal is not a value here
mutations.completionMarker: ok a block reference above a shadowing `let` is the dead zone, not the outer binding
mutations.cell: a bigint literal is not a value here
mutations.note: With the refusal gone `1n` validates and runs, producing a value whose typeof no admitted kind names — the measured pre-fix behavior.

mutations.name: the parallel/race worktree check is gone, so two branches share one tree
mutations.expectRed: two parallel branches spawning into one literal worktree
mutations.completionMarker: ok even in arithmetic that never crosses a boundary
mutations.cell: two parallel branches spawning into one literal worktree
mutations.note: The whole branch-collision arm deleted at its guard. Measured 2026-09-03: the parallel cell is the first red (the race cell is behind it in this fail-fast suite), with 118 upstream oks ending at the bigint arithmetic cell.

mutations.name: the fanOut worktree check is gone, so every branch spawns into one tree
mutations.expectRed: a fanOut whose function spawns a literal worktree runs it in every branch
mutations.completionMarker: ok two race branches spawning into one literal worktree
mutations.cell: a fanOut whose function spawns a literal worktree runs it in every branch
mutations.note: The fanOut arm is deletable separately from the branch-collision arm, which is why it has its own mutant. Measured 2026-09-03: the fanOut cell reds with 120 upstream oks, the parallel and race rejects among them still holding.

mutations.name: the same-branch exemption is gone, so one branch reusing its own tree is refused
mutations.expectRed: one branch spawning the same worktree twice runs alone in it
mutations.completionMarker: ok branches with their own worktrees are legal
mutations.cell: one branch spawning the same worktree twice runs alone in it
mutations.note: The distinctness check is what keeps L3022 about CONCURRENT sharing rather than any repetition: a branch runs alone in its own tree, so spawning into it twice is legal. Measured 2026-09-03: the acceptance cell reds (expected acceptance, got L3022) with 123 upstream oks, every reject cell still holding.
